llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says (manage ERC-4337 accounts) and sensibly warns NOT to paste private keys. Before installing, confirm the following with the skill author or runtime operator: (1) which exact environment variables the runtime will require in production — specifically ask whether a SIGNER_URL and SIGNER_AUTH_TOKEN (or DASHBOARD_API_KEY) will be needed, and request they be declared in the skill metadata; (2) ensure any RPC URL you provide does not expose long-lived keys you don't want logged or audited (hosted RPC endpoints often include API keys in the URL); (3) require external signing (HSM/MPC) or wallet connector for any transaction that moves funds — never allow the agent to hold owner EOA private keys; (4) restrict autonomous use: run first on a testnet or with minimal funds and use scoped session keys with tight caps and short TTLs; (5) ask how signer tokens are rotated/revoked and where they are stored. These checks would reduce risk; the missing declared env vars for signer/auth are the primary reason this review is flagged as "suspicious." If the author updates the manifest to declare signer-related secret env variables and documents signer authentication/rotation and dashboard-key usage, confidence could be raised to high.
